item.title: Gambling is the hidden addiction — here's what we built against it
item.description: Gambling addiction doesn't leave marks. No needle marks, no smell on someone's breath, nothing a blood test picks up. That's why they call it the hidden addiction — someone can be quietly falling apart, financially and emotionally, while looking completely fine to everyone around them.

item.title: One shared core, two phones: the first decision, and why it wasn't purely technical
item.description: Before any of this had a shared module or even a name that stuck, it was a much simpler idea: watch someone's real bank activity for gambling, and tell them the truth about it instead of leaving that to memory or denial.
